content:
{'text': '隨著 iOS 26.6、iPadOS 26.6 及相關軟件更新推出，Apple 詳細公布了今日新作業系統版本所包含的大量安全修補。', 'tr': "Alongside the rollout of iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and related software updates, Apple has detailed the extensive security patches included in today's new operating system versions."}

{'text': 'iOS 26.6 及 iPadOS 26.6 的 Apple 安全性更新從多方面影響 iPhone 及 iPad', 'tr': "Apple's security updates in iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6 affect iPhones and iPads in multiple ways"}

{'text': '在 iOS 26.6 及 iPadOS 26.6 中，Apple 詳細列出超過 75 項針對 iPhone 和 iPad 的安全修補。這些修補涵蓋系統的廣泛範疇。', 'tr': 'In iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6, Apple details more than 75 security patches for iPhone and iPad. These patches cover a wide range of areas across the system.'}

{'text': '更準確地說，Apple 的安全公告包含 78 條個別漏洞條目，涉及 87 個獨特的 CVE 編號。CVE 數量較高，是因為部分條目涉及多於一個 CVE。', 'tr': "More precisely, Apple's security advisory contains 78 individual vulnerability entries involving 87 unique CVE identifiers. The higher CVE count is because some entries involve more than one CVE."}

{'text': 'Apple 並未表示 iOS 26.6 中修補的任何漏洞曾遭野外實際利用。', 'tr': 'Apple has not indicated that any of the vulnerabilities patched in iOS 26.6 have been exploited in the wild.'}

{'text': '在 Apple 冗長的修補清單中，有數項尤其值得留意：', 'tr': "Among Apple's lengthy list of patches, several stand out as particularly noteworthy:"}

  • {'text': 'MediaRemote 的漏洞可能讓應用程式取得 root 權限。', 'tr': 'A vulnerability in MediaRemote could allow an app to gain root privileges.'}
  • {'text': 'AVEVideoEncoder 的漏洞可能讓應用程式以核心權限執行任意程式碼。', 'tr': 'A vulnerability in AVEVideoEncoder could allow an app to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.'}
  • {'text': 'Game Center 及 libc 的漏洞可能讓惡意應用程式逃離沙盒（sandbox）。', 'tr': 'Vulnerabilities in Game Center and libc could allow a malicious app to escape its sandbox.'}
  • {'text': 'CloudAttestation 的漏洞可能讓惡意應用程式繞過程式碼簽署（code-signing）強制機制。', 'tr': 'A vulnerability in CloudAttestation could allow a malicious app to bypass code-signing enforcement.'}
  • {'text': 'ImageIO 的漏洞在處理特製惡意影像時，可能導致任意程式碼執行。', 'tr': 'A vulnerability in ImageIO could lead to arbitrary code execution when processing a specially crafted malicious image.'}
  • {'text': '三項 SceneKit 漏洞在處理特製惡意檔案時，可能導致任意程式碼執行。', 'tr': 'Three SceneKit vulnerabilities could lead to arbitrary code execution when processing a specially crafted malicious file.'}
  • {'text': '無障礙功能的問題可能透過 iPhone 鏡像功能，將敏感資料洩露予取得實體接觸權限的人。', 'tr': 'An Accessibility issue could potentially disclose sensitive information to someone with physical access through iPhone Mirroring.'}
  • {'text': '通訊錄的漏洞可能讓應用程式在未獲用戶授權下新增聯絡人。', 'tr': 'A vulnerability in Contacts could allow an app to add contacts without user authorization.'}

{'text': '核心、WebKit 及 Wi-Fi 修補', 'tr': 'Kernel, WebKit, and Wi-Fi patches'}

{'text': 'Apple 同時修補了十多項核心漏洞。潛在影響包括破壞或寫入核心記憶體、洩露核心記憶體、繞過網絡過濾器，以及導致系統意外終止。', 'tr': 'Apple also patched over a dozen kernel vulnerabilities. Potential impacts include corrupting or writing to kernel memory, leaking kernel memory, bypassing network filters, and causing unexpected system termination.'}

{'text': 'WebKit 亦獲得數量可觀的修補。這些漏洞可能導致程序記憶體外洩、洩露用戶是否曾造訪某連結、進行介面欺詐、違反 iframe 沙盒規則、讓應用程式讀取沙盒以外的檔案，或導致 Safari 崩潰。', 'tr': 'WebKit also received a substantial number of patches. These vulnerabilities could lead to process memory disclosure, reveal whether a user has visited a particular link, enable UI spoofing, violate iframe sandboxing rules, allow an app to read files outside its sandbox, or cause Safari to crash.'}

{'text': '另一項 Wi-Fi 漏洞可能讓附近的攻擊者破壞程序記憶體。', 'tr': 'Another Wi-Fi vulnerability could allow a nearby attacker to corrupt process memory.'}

{'text': '在 78 項已記錄的安全修補之後，Apple 另外提供一個「額外致謝」（Additional recognition）部分，列出 12 項致謝名單。', 'tr': 'Following the 78 documented security patches, Apple includes an "Additional Recognition" section listing 12 acknowledgments.'}

{'text': '這些條目用以感謝研究人員的協助，但並非以獨立安全修補形式呈現，亦未獲指派額外的 CVE 編號。', 'tr': 'These entries thank researchers for their assistance but are not presented as separate security patches and have not been assigned additional CVE identifiers.'}

{'text': '完整修補清單及研究人員致謝名單可在 Apple 網站查閱。', 'tr': "The full list of patches and researcher acknowledgments is available on Apple's website."}

{'text': 'Mac、Apple Watch、Apple TV 及 Apple Vision Pro 的安全修補', 'tr': 'Security patches for Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro'}

{'text': 'Apple 最新公布的 macOS Tahoe 26.6 安全性說明列出 155 個獨特 CVE。', 'tr': "Apple's newly published macOS Tahoe 26.6 security notes list 155 unique CVEs."}

{'text': '除多項與 iPhone 及 iPad 共通的修補外，Mac 更新亦針對可讓應用程式取得 root 權限、逃離沙盒、繞過 Gatekeeper 檢查或私隱偏好設定，以及存取受保護資料的漏洞。', 'tr': 'In addition to several patches shared with iPhone and iPad, the Mac update addresses vulnerabilities that could allow an app to gain root privileges, escape the sandbox, bypass Gatekeeper checks or privacy preferences, and access protected data.'}

{'text': 'Apple 亦於今日為較舊版本 macOS 發布了安全性更新，但這些未納入本文統計。', 'tr': "Apple also released security updates today for older versions of macOS, but these are not included in this article's count."}

{'text': 'Apple 亦詳細公布了 watchOS 26.6、tvOS 26.6 及 visionOS 26.6 的修補。在剔除跨平台重疊後，Apple 最新更新合共處理 194 個獨特 CVE。', 'tr': "Apple has also detailed patches for watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and visionOS 26.6. After removing cross-platform overlaps, Apple's latest updates address a combined total of 194 unique CVEs."}

{'text': 'Apple 較早前曾透露，因應人工智能驅動的攻擊工具，公司加快了一批安全修補的推出，並提前於上月的 iOS 26.5.2 更新中發布。', 'tr': "Apple previously revealed that, in response to AI-driven attack tools, the company accelerated the rollout of a batch of security patches, releasing them early in last month's iOS 26.5.2 update."}

{'text': '讓你的 Apple 產品發揮更大功效', 'tr': 'Get the most out of your Apple products'}
